initialPrompts.sieg: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a registration-locked garment overlay for the fixed premium anime boxer. Image 1 is the EXACT body silhouette and 768x800 coordinate canvas to fit; image 2 is the exact black athletic shirt design and material reference (its pose is NOT the target). Keep image 1's full canvas, scale, center, empty margins and pose. Draw a fitted short-sleeved athletic shirt over the chest, shoulders and waist of image1, then output ONLY the garment with genuine transparent background, NO skin or human parts. Preserve the complete naturally broad deltoid volume of the reference body. The shirt must have connected, continuous shoulder-to-chest fabric and smooth anatomically correct armholes, no tiny detached caps or puffed shoulder pads. Soft premium anime-painted black athletic knit, subtle grey highlights, thin gold neckline/cuff trim and gold side piping exactly like image2. Shirt follows actual body side contours with slight garment ease, no exposed skin wedges along torso. Neck opening centered x384 with U bottom around y276, endpoints at actual neck base near (338,218) and (432,218). Waist hem y550, x300 to465. Black cloth fully opaque; inside neck and outside silhouette alpha zero. No body, skin, arms, hands, face, trousers, belt, coat, mannequin, text, logos, shadows outside the garment, extra pieces or contact sheet. No recentering, cropping, arbitrary rescaling, changing pose or enlarging the garment to fill the page. Preserve image1's exact relative coordinates; output same 768:800 canvas aspect ratio. Target is SIEGER victory pose: screen-left arm hangs down, screen-right arm raised steeply diagonally upward. Left shoulder follows body around (272,259), cuff crosses upper arm near (258,360). Right shoulder follows body around (463,214); right short sleeve follows the raised deltoid and upper arm to cuff around (515,197), leaving the raised forearm bare/transparent. Follow real curved chest/armpit at (474,310). Right neckline and armhole must connect continuously with naturally stretched folds; no horizontal shoulder shelf. Cover the entire original deltoid and upper torso without shrinking shoulders.

correctionPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the target garment overlay on a 1229x1280 transparent canvas. Image 2 is the exact underlying fixed 768x800 boxer body, which scales by 1.6 to the garment canvas. Keep the ENTIRE garment canvas size, placement, sleeve pose, shoulder shape and material unchanged. Make ONLY anatomical fit corrections: extend the hem DOWN from about y820 to y880 (equivalent world y550), with hem endpoints near x480 and x745, so there is no bare belly band at the belt. Widen the torso fabric where needed to cover ALL underlying ribcage/lat silhouette: world left side approximately (299,360),(305,430),(309,480),(300,550), and world right side approximately (480,325),(480,380),(465,450),(460,495),(465,550). Garment side edges must sit just outside this fixed body, not cut into it like a corset. Keep natural cloth fit and waist taper. Deepen neck opening slightly: collar endpoints approximately source (537,349) and (692,349), center bottom source (614,443). Keep collar hole transparent. Do not move the shoulders, short cuffs or raised sleeve; preserve their current exact coordinates. Same black soft athletic fabric, gold seam piping, premium anime painting. Output ONLY this single complete shirt. Absolutely no body or skin pixels, no extra parts, no opaque background. Preserve genuine alpha zero outside, opaque cloth, full original empty canvas margins.

samuraiCoats.sieg: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create an exact registered CLOTHING-ONLY overlay for an existing premium anime boxer. Image1 is the exact target 768x1216 full-body pose, positioning and canvas. Image2 is the coat design, image3 the sleeve leather/gold style. Fit a complete front coat including attached long sleeves to the exact body of image1. Then remove ALL human pixels, face, skin, hair, gloves, pants, shoes and background: output ONLY the open coat front and its sleeves on genuine transparent background. Keep same 768:1216 full canvas extent and relative placement, no cropping/recentering/enlarging to fill. Coat must have natural broad athletic shoulders with continuous armholes and realistic rounded deltoid volume. Black premium painted supple leather, rich gold turned collar and lapels, gold piping/cuff trim matching references. Open central chest and waist/pants area stays transparent. Long left and right front panels descend to y930 with crown emblems near their hems, like image2. Full sleeves stop at actual wrists under glove cuffs. Collar around y200..270 x300..470; torso/waist center x384,y550. All interior cloth opaque, all openings and outside alpha0. No cape/back layer or cloth spanning between legs, no pants material baked in. No text, extra objects or lighting/background effects. Target SIEGER victory pose, left wrist around (199,630), left shoulder (274,276); right arm steeply raised, shoulder (465,219), elbow (546,160), right wrist (589,62). Trace exact actual muscular silhouette with comfortable coat ease. Maintain full shoulder breadth.
